# NeoLibrary

> NeoLibrary, by Rob Tyrie of Ironstone Advisory, is an open engine that turns a collection of documents into connected knowledge objects that keep their sources. It grew out of MetaRAG (June 2024): grounding language models in a curated, consensus library of documents instead of a database. Code is Apache 2.0; documents are CC BY 4.0.

## Canonical definitions

- [RFC-0001: definitions and scope](https://github.com/Ironstone-Advisory/neolibrary/blob/main/rfcs/RFC-0001-definitions.md): NeoLibrary, MetaRAG, book (document), knowledge object, provenance spine, Neolibrarian, DAC-EK, the Helix
- [RFC-0002: knowledge objects and the provenance spine](https://github.com/Ironstone-Advisory/neolibrary/blob/main/rfcs/RFC-0002-knowledge-objects-and-provenance.md): the rules every knowledge object follows
- [RFC-0003: plugin contract and open-core boundary](https://github.com/Ironstone-Advisory/neolibrary/blob/main/rfcs/RFC-0003-plugin-contract.md)
- [RFC-0004: how NeoLibrary is built (creative flow and skeptic gate)](https://github.com/Ironstone-Advisory/neolibrary/blob/main/rfcs/RFC-0004-how-we-build.md)

## Ironstone methods

- [RFC-0005: the Ironstone Creation Model](https://github.com/Ironstone-Advisory/neolibrary/blob/main/rfcs/RFC-0005-creation-model.md): eight intrinsic energies a company controls (ideate, think, make, do, judge, decide, execute, archive) and four extrinsic ones it does not (fans, skeptics, competition, the law), with feedback loops across all twelve;, run in parallel to take an idea to market, each trading demands and outputs with the others
- [RFC-0006: the Ironstone Critical Thinking Cube](https://github.com/Ironstone-Advisory/neolibrary/blob/main/rfcs/RFC-0006-critical-thinking-cube.md): six faces (5 Ws, 5 Whys, 5 Hows, 5 Whens, 5 Wise, 5 Weirds), each sorted into a SWOT grid
- [RFC-0007: the Evidence Ladder](https://github.com/Ironstone-Advisory/neolibrary/blob/main/rfcs/RFC-0007-evidence-ladder.md): E0 assertion to E4 repeated; confidence can't exceed the evidence
